message: That's precisely the blurb I wanted to ask permission to steal. In return, I offer you this from Dr. Matt Cartmill, evolutionary anthropologist at Duke (hardly an obscure quote, but I like it for its academic universality): "As an adolescent I aspired to lasting fame, I craved factual certainty, and I thirsted for a meaningful vision of human life--so I became a scientist. This is like becoming an archbishop so you can meet girls."
